sections.Profile:
Bone Busters Inc. , released by Gottlieb in August 1989, is a four-player solid-state game with a supernatural skeleton theme, designed by Ray Tanzer with artwork by Constantino Mitchell and Jeanine Mitchell. A talking skeleton head with moving teeth sits on top of the backbox, play includes a four-ball multiball, and 2,000 were built.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1989–1991
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State

- Players: 4
